title: Inside the Fallen Heart Flame
summary: In the Jia Ma Empire's capital, Hai Bodong and Ya Fei of the Mite'er family shelter Xiao Ding and the surviving Xiao Clan. Deep underground, Xiao Yan wakes inside the Fallen Heart Flame after about half a month. Yao Lao has been shielding him with the Bone Chilling Flame. He says it will last three more days, after which he will pour his remaining Soul Power into Xiao Yan and fall into a deep sleep. At the academy, Zi Yan takes charge of the Rock Gate, and Su Qian seals the lowest floor and plans revenge on the Black-Corner Region. He also sends someone to guard Xiao Yan's brother Xiao Li. Yao Lao goes to sleep, and Medusa wakes inside the lava world and attacks the flame, which only makes its heat worse, and Xiao Yan loses consciousness.
